layout_architecture.login_page: Split screen layout with left brand gradient panel (floating widgets, avatar circles, quote) and right interactive form (Google SSO, email input, quick Demo mode switch).
layout_architecture.desktop_layout: Three-panel desktop architecture: Left sidebar (Fixed 240px, includes workspace logo, search ⌘K, Home, Messages, Groups, Directory, Org Structure, Tasks, Projects, Polls, Notifications, Settings, Profile & Theme shortcut at bottom), Center main workspace view, and Collapsible Right context panel (Details, Thread, Member status, Activity feed).
layout_architecture.mobile_layout: Bottom navigation bar (Home, Messages, Tasks, Notifications) with a sliding 'More' drawer for Directory, Org Chart, Polls, and Settings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use .js / .jsx format matching the React set-up in /src.
Import Lucide icons for UI actions and navigation.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key data display elements (e.g., data-testid='login-google-button', data-testid='sidebar-home-link', data-testid='kanban-column-todo').
Ensure dropdowns, modals, and tooltips have non-transparent backgrounds (e.g., bg-white dark:bg-[#171E2E] shadow-xl) to avoid text overlap issues.
Implement smooth micro-interactions on hover and active states without breaking CSS transforms.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center-align the main App container globally.
Use generous padding inside bordered containers (p-4 to p-6).
Strictly avoid generic AI emojis as UI icons; use Lucide react icons instead.
Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for standard text).
